context._modelIdNote: Verified 2026-08-04 against account 146259920030 via `aws bedrock list-foundation-models --region us-east-1 --by-provider anthropic` and `aws bedrock list-inference-profiles --region us-east-1`. In us-east-1 all current Claude models are reachable ONLY through an inference profile (us.anthropic.* / global.anthropic.*); a bare anthropic.claude-* id fails with 'on-demand throughput isn't supported'. Re-verify before changing (ADR-005).
context._allowedOriginNote: CORS origin for direct calls to the execute-api URL. The deployed UI is same-origin behind CloudFront (ADR-008), so the browser never relies on this and '*' is not a weakening: the API key, which CORS cannot supply, is still required. Set a specific origin if you expose the API to another site.
context._alertEmailNote: Optional. Address subscribed to the CloudWatch alarms and the $5 budget. Left empty so no personal address is committed to the repository; the alarms and budget are created either way, they simply have no delivery target until this is set.
